description: Source code for the PyTorch JIT tracer, including functions for recording and managing tracing states, handling inputs/outputs, and managing source location and warnings.

classes.name: TracingState
classes.description: Manages the state during tracing, including the computation graph, environment stack, and related utilities.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Performs tracing of a function with given inputs, producing a computation graph and output stack.

methods.name: pauseTracing
methods.description: Pauses the current tracing state, allowing temporary suspension of tracing.

methods.name: abandon
methods.description: Aborts the current tracing session, resetting the tracing state.

methods.name: setWarn
methods.description: Sets the warning callback function for tracer warnings.

methods.name: recordSourceLocation
methods.description: Records source location information for a node, used for debugging and source tracking.

methods.name: addInputs
methods.description: Adds an input to a node in the trace graph, with various overloads for different data types.

methods.name: addOutput
methods.description: Adds an output tensor to a node in the trace graph.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the output value and type for a node.

methods.name: getSizeOf
methods.description: Creates a traced variable representing the size of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: getNumelOf
methods.description: Creates a traced variable representing the number of elements in a tensor.

methods.name: ensureUniqueIfOutOfPlaced
methods.description: Checks and warns if a tensor has multiple references when performing in-place operations during tracing.
